note: Fixtures for the job classifier, written against the demo org's catalog (AC repair, AC installation, Routine maintenance, Gas refilling, Duct cleaning). Inputs are deliberately messy — short, mixed English/Urdu, sometimes vague — because that is what a dispatcher actually receives. `priority` is scored with one-step tolerance since it is a judgement call; `service` is scored strictly.
